name: THE I-13 WORLD
algo: sha256(name|slug|blurb) folded pairwise (merkle) to a single root
verify: each leaf carries its own proof: fold the leaf seal up it (side R: h(x+sib), side L: h(sib+x)) and you land on root. The tree is rebuildable from the seals alone, in index order, pairing (a,b) as h(a+b) and duplicating a lone last node.
note: Every World V inhabitant folds to ROOT_0. Live: the root updates as the I-13 world grows. One continuous chain: every leaf carries its proof here, so this file alone verifies the whole world.
author: David Lee Wise / ROOT0 / TriPod LLC
